capabilities: Render a weekly habit tracker in a DataviewJS code block
Collect habit data annotated in daily notes via Dataview
Display up to 7 habits for a calendar week
extras: Stated limitation: supports at most 7 habits; usage requires writing DataviewJS blocks that query daily-note annotations.
intentEvidence: created on the foundation of the Heatmap Calendar by Richard Slettevoll
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize habit data recorded across daily notes over a calendar week.

relations.evidence: Visualise your Habits based on DataViewJS in Obsidian
This Plugin has been created on the foundation of the Heatmap Calendar

summary: DataviewJS renderer that displays a weekly habit tracker built from data annotated in daily notes.
